state:
Goal `core-test-1-2`, stage 2. `Core\Test::advance` has every proof: `about.md`, three examples, one
attack, a Rust test (`advance_stops_at_the_last_instant_and_keeps_the_clock_it_refused_to_move`), and
a `perf` skip in `data/proofs/policy.json`, because a bench runs under `nvs run`, where no clock is fixed.
`Core\Test` now has its class card. The attack found a panic in `jiff`'s `Timestamp::from_nanosecond`
past year 9999. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs`'s `instant_at_nanos` now builds through
`Timestamp::new`, and its doc comment says why.

Every `Core\Test` member's proofs run under `nvs run`, not `nvs test` (see the playbook bullet in
*Writing a test case*). Run each example and attack under `target/debug/nvs.exe test <file>` by hand
before blessing.
